## About
DF Auto Collision is an auto body shop on S Maple Ave in South San Francisco. We handle collision repair, dent repair, paint and color matching, framework, and interior and exterior detailing.
We work with all insurance companies, and collision repair estimates are free. One customer told us their door looked "perfect as before the crash," and another said the color "blends in perfectly, as if there had never been an accident."
We're rated 4.6 from 82 Google reviews. Come by the shop and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision and auto body repair: Body repair after an accident, from damaged doors to panels.
- Paint and color matching: Full paint service, with custom color matching for your car.
- Framework straightening: Straightening and fixing your car's frame after a collision.
- Detailing: Full detailing for the interior, exterior, engine and wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Collision repair estimates are free.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 233 S Maple Ave, Unit P, in South San Francisco.

Antonio maintained excellent customer service throughout. During the estimation, he took the time to show me visuals of the affected components and helped me understand why the costs were what they were. He called whenever he had updates, and was transparent consistently. Once the parts arrived, the team got the job done in just 4 days.
